test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bb036815b4d6110b075d34b98814cd9f4097a063c7f5dd0cabe7cd053ee73ef.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) For the elements at the sides (in 1st box) → Shift in the anticlockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe86156880dbf2d74241827ef5af1912f40ea5c840a4edd3aba9154ee25ed1b6.png] 

2) For the elements at the corners (in 1st box) → Shift in the anticlockwise direction and is replaced by a new element alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c53ec8bf8f2cfe00623cbb28d5f19e42f9540b78a7d12696dd2c00caf186d519.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2144d6106e1fd1692e469aa5ef426ab4a29bad7face02cc5e7ded55f9660e7f.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
